networks.review: Extend public road, building and dungeon links. Measure direction-specific time ranges and confirm access through doors, ladders, gates and obstacle crossings.

The carried-fuel model has six stops and four post-quest discovery flights. Verify temporary boosts, stored fuel deposits and withdrawals, failed-flight returns, and arrival or diary registration rules.

Varrock, Lumbridge and Falador cast edges grant Magic XP and consume runes. Each directed edge is bounded to one cast. Review other destinations, rune-pouch or staff alternatives, and teleport restrictions.
Collect spellbook unlocks and switching points, individual rune and skill requirements, and teleport landing tiles. Match spell availability to the selected spellbook.
The tutorial release documents a cooldown and Lumbridge arrival. Capture the exact live cooldown, spellbook-dependent destinations and cast restrictions before loading reusable edges.
The draft has Varrock market-square tablets. Collect landing settings, redirect variants, charge or item costs, and any destination quest or diary gates for other consumable teleports.
Use separate item states or counters for charge counts, including the last charge and recharging. Record inventory or equipped use, destination gates and who can acquire each item.
Entrana and Fossil Island have edges. Inventory port connections, charter fares and discounts, landings, ship unlocks and routes that only depart or arrive in one direction.
Reconcile Tree Gnome Village and later hub or destination unlocks. Separate permanent trees, Farming-grown trees and house services.
The Godfather conversation and staff-gated A.I.Q. and D.I.S. routes are modeled. Review remaining codes, special destinations and the Ardougne Elite diary bypass.
Verify Grand Tree access, routes that require additional quests, and crash-site or one-way landing exceptions.
Inventory canoes, minecarts, carpet rides, shortcuts, tunnels, levers and one-way instance exits. Capture real entry checks, fees, travel items and landing tiles.
Connect each transport item or destination to its specific diary claim. Capture item ownership, daily-use limits, recharge rules and upgrades.
Camp walking and barge edges use the Bone Voyage unlock. Capture Digsite pendant attunement, discovered mushtrees and local rowboat links as independent gates.
The Varrock, Lumbridge and Falador portals from Rimmington assume a World 330 host with those destinations installed. Inventory other destinations, exact arrival tiles and access restrictions.
Verify the shared cooldown, group prerequisites, equipment and combat restrictions, and exact arrivals.
Apply the policy to entries and crossings. Verify level-dependent teleport limits and separate two-way links from Wilderness-only exits.
No death shortcut is loaded. A future route needs an explicit respawn point and item loss or recovery model.
No world-hop shortcut is loaded. A future route needs an explicit world and transition model.
